latestVersion.changelog:
Initial version — introduces responsibility extraction for oversized classes using Feathers' heuristics.

- Detects "big class" anti-patterns based on method/variable count and edit patterns.
- Applies Feathers' 7 responsibility heuristics plus feature sketches to identify responsibility clusters within large classes.
- Produces a visual responsibility map and step-by-step extraction plan, tailored to the current change.
- Aims to help developers split "god classes" incrementally, reducing risk and focusing only on needed areas.
- Targets intermediate–advanced engineers working with legacy, bloat-prone codebases.
